SELECT 
  fished_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as boat_count,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  AVG(CAST(yt AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(anglers, 0)) as yt_per_angler,
  MIN(yt) as min_yt,
  MAX(yt) as max_yt
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season = 6 
  AND fished_date_doy >= 60 
  AND fished_date_doy <= 91
GROUP BY fished_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fished_date_doy, cls
LIMIT 100;

].copy()

    'wtmp_c': ['min', 'max', 'mean', 'count']
}).reset_index()

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as boats_available,
  MIN(fish_date_doy) as first_available
FROM schedule
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 
  AND fish_date_doy >= 92 
  AND fish_date_doy <= 106
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls
LIMIT 50;
